facts.text: The hotel sits on Dubai Creek.
facts.excerpt: Perched on Dubai Creek, InterContinental Dubai Festival City redefines luxury

facts.text: The hotel offers access to Dubai Festival City Mall.
facts.excerpt: a 4,250 m² Event Centre, and seamless access to Dubai Festival City Mall

facts.text: The hotel has a glass-bottom infinity pool suspended above the hotel's fourth floor.
facts.excerpt: Don’t miss the glass-bottom Infinity Pool, suspended above the hotel’s fourth floor - a truly unique experience.

facts.text: The infinity pool has temperature-controlled water for year-round swimming.
facts.excerpt: With temperature-controlled waters, our pool offers a delightful swimming experience year-round

facts.text: The pool has a poolside bar serving drinks and snacks with views of the Dubai skyline.
facts.excerpt: Bask in the sun while taking in the breathtaking panoramic views of the Dubai skyline from our world-renowned glass infinity pool. Indulge in refreshing drinks and gourmet snacks from our poolside bar.

facts.text: SPA InterContinental offers bespoke treatments, a selection of pools and a 24-hour fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy bespoke treatments, a selection of pools, and a 24-hour fitness centre.

facts.text: Rooms feature marble floors and vibrant jewel tones.
facts.excerpt: Marvel at the picturesque vistas enhanced by marble floors and vibrant jewel tones.

facts.text: Rooms include touches such as a standalone bathtub and premium bedding.
facts.excerpt: from indulgent toiletries to a standalone bathtub, ensuring relaxation after a bustling day. Sink into premium bedding

facts.text: Rooms and suites have panoramic Dubai Creek views.
facts.excerpt: a luxury hotel in Dubai with panoramic Dubai Creek views

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 26th floor with panoramic city views and personalised check-in.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 26th floor, the exclusive Club Lounge offers panoramic city views, perfect for relaxation. Enjoy personalised check-in and bespoke services

facts.text: Pierre's TT serves French cuisine by three Michelin-starred chef Pierre Gagnaire in a waterfront setting.
facts.excerpt: Delight in the artistry of three Michelin starred Chef Pierre Gagnaire at Pierres TT. Savour authentic French cuisine, exceptional mixology, and a waterfront ambience

facts.text: Eclipse is a cocktail bar on the 26th floor hidden behind a bookcase.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away behind the bookcase like a hidden gem, Eclipse beckons those seeking a secret world of exotic cocktails

facts.text: Vista has 180-degree views of Dubai Creek and the skyline.
facts.excerpt: breathtaking 180 degree views of Dubai Creek and the skyline

facts.text: Planet Trekkers kids' club offers activities like rock climbing, arts and crafts and cooking classes.
facts.excerpt: Planet Trekkers, a dynamic kids’ club that urges young explorers to dive into unique activities like rock climbing, arts and crafts, cooking classes

facts.text: Dubai Festival City Mall has the IMAGINE water, laser and fire show.
facts.excerpt: Dubai Festival City Mall boasts 400+ retail stores and the record-breaking IMAGINE water, laser, and fire show.

facts.text: The hotel is about 4 kilometers from Dubai International Airport.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
